## Württemberg, Germany - 1780-1830

German children baptised with two or more given names were often called by the second in daily life (the wiki's example: Johann Christoph and Johann Friedrich were usually called Christoph and Friedrich) — search later records under the second given name alone as well as the full baptismal name. (FamilySearch Wiki: https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Germany_Naming_Customs)
